name: From Myself in Another Dimension
overview: "From Myself in Another Dimension" is an anthology documentary series with each episode presenting a self-contained narrative. Hosted by Nima Beheshtinia, the series follows a journey across different parts of the world, engaging with local communities and individuals. Through conversations shaped by music, culture, food, art and everyday human experiences, the series offers an intimate and human-centered perspective on life across diverse societies.
